title: Marisol | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoor living takes center stage with a heated private pool and summer kitchen, creating the perfect setting for afternoons of relaxation and evening gatherings. The highlight of the home is the spectacular rooftop terrace, where panoramic views of the emerald Gulf and sugar-white sands create an unforgettable backdrop for sunrise coffee or sunset cocktails. Two nearby beach accesses make reaching the shoreline effortless, while the included six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring Inlet Beach, 30Avenue, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach easy and enjoyable. Designed for connection, comfort, and incredible coastal scenery, this exceptional retreat offers the perfect setting for an unforgettable stay along 30A. Rising four stories in the heart of Inlet Beach, this stunning coastal retreat offers over 5,600 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space paired with sweeping, unobstructed Gulf views. Designed for memorable gatherings, the home features bright open living areas, a chef-inspired kitchen with premium appliances, and beautifully appointed bedrooms that provide both comfort and privacy for larger groups. Expansive windows and balconies frame the turquoise waters beyond, while an elevator provides convenient access to every level of the home.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
